PaginationMeta.description: Offset-based pagination metadata (used by most list endpoints)

CursorPaginationMeta.description: Cursor-based pagination metadata (used by notifications and some endpoints)

abilities.description: Computed capability flags for the company. Applies to both the company-level e_invoice_serial/e_archive_serial fields above and the same fields on each of the company's integrations, since configurability depends solely on the company's accounting provider.

e_invoice_serial_configurable.description: Whether the accounting provider allows configuring a custom e_invoice_serial (currently QNB, Isnet, TrendyolEFaturam, ELogo, UyumsoftEInvoice, HepsiburadaEFaturam).

e_archive_serial_configurable.description: Whether the accounting provider allows configuring a custom e_archive_serial (currently QNB, Isnet, TrendyolEFaturam, Mikro, ELogo, UyumsoftEInvoice, HepsiburadaEFaturam).

OrderShippingResponse.description: Order shipping information for shippable orders.

order_ids.description: Numeric ids of the orders to generate e-invoices for.

e_invoice_serial.description: Custom e-invoice serial prefix. Only accepted when the company's accounting provider supports it (currently QNB, Isnet, TrendyolEFaturam, ELogo, UyumsoftEInvoice, HepsiburadaEFaturam).

e_archive_serial.description: Custom e-archive serial prefix. Only accepted when the company's accounting provider supports it (currently QNB, Isnet, TrendyolEFaturam, Mikro, ELogo, UyumsoftEInvoice, HepsiburadaEFaturam). Whether these fields are configurable is exposed on the owning company's `abilities` (see `CompanyResponse`), not per integration, since it depends solely on the company's accounting provider.
